# Step - embedders

`embedders` · category: [Vectors](../../traversal/step_reference.md#vectors)

Lists the registered embedders (name, model, dimension, element, metric, ...), the default first.

## Forms

```text
embedders()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.embedders()[0].name   // hash-ngram/1
```
